description: Load this skill whenever the project must support speech input or voice control — dictation, "click by voice" grammars, Dragon NaturallySpeaking, Voice Control (iOS/macOS), Voice Access (Android), or any interface where users activate controls by speaking. Under no circumstances let an aria-label override a visible label without keeping the visible text intact and in order. Absolutely always ensure the accessible name contains the visible label, and load alongside keyboard/SKILL.md since speech tools commonly emulate keyboard and pointer input.
